title: M62 closed near Milnrow after lorry hits central reservation
excerpt: The M62 was closed near junction 21 at Milnrow on Sunday afternoon after a lorry hit the central reservation, the Lancashire Telegraph reported.
body:
The M62 was closed near junction 21 at Milnrow on Sunday afternoon, 15 November, after a lorry hit the central reservation, cutting off a main route for Rochdale drivers.

The Lancashire Telegraph reported the closure in a live report it shared at about 4.20pm.

Junction 21 serves Milnrow, Newhey and Shaw. It is the last junction before the M62 climbs to junction 22 on the Pennines.

It was not yet confirmed which carriageway was closed, whether anyone was hurt, or when the motorway would reopen.

The same stretch, between junctions 22 and 21, was closed westbound on 10 and 11 October after a serious crash involving several vehicles.

Drivers can check live closures and diversions on National Highways' traffic information service before setting off.

This story will be updated as National Highways and the emergency services confirm details.

Source: Lancashire Telegraph live report, 15 November 2026. Photograph: Rochdale Daily stock image.
